Good evening to the chair and members of Council, Matthew Lauren Director of Recreation and Community Development.
The report before Council outlines a proposal from ham construction through cross developments incorporated.
To purchase approximately 11.5 acres of city owned municipal reserve land at 1.34 English crescent.
To support an expansion of its existing corporate headquarters.
Administration has negotiated a conditional sales agreement for the property at a purchase price of approximately 7.76 million dollars, which represents fair market value.
As part of the proposed agreement, ham construction would be responsible for funding and constructing replacement facilities for the North Saskatchewan Rugby Union,
at the city owned 15.3 acre municipal reserve site at Lambert, Crescent and 15th Street East.
The replacement facility would include two regulation-sized rugby fields with lighting, additional field space that could accommodate youth through other sports programming,
parking and the relocation of the existing clubhouse.
The North Saskatchewan Rugby Union has been involved in discussions regarding the proposed relocation and has confirmed its support for the planned improvements.
While administration generally does not support the sale of municipal reserve lands, this proposal presents an opportunity to accommodate the expansion of an existing business,
while maintaining recreational programming and providing additional developed green space for communities.
The proceeds from the sale would be directed to the city's dedicated lands account, where they would remain available for eligible parkland and recreational investments.
Administration would also report back with options to offset the loss of municipal reserve land through future land acquisitions or improvements to existing park spaces.
In accordance to council policy, C01-02-1, public notice for this proposed sale was advertised on November 2, 2026 at City Hall and on the city's website.
Administration is seeking council's approval to proceed with the conditional sale in alignment with report recommendations,
and administration along with representatives from ham construction and the North Saskatchewan Rugby Union are available to answer questions.
